description.la: Libellus Bernardi ad Haimericum cardinalem, de causa et modo diligendi Deum et de quattuor gradibus amoris: «causa diligendi Deum, Deus est; modus, sine modo diligere». Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 182, 1854), cum Admonitione Mabillonii.
description.en-US: Bernard’s little treatise for Cardinal Haimeric on why and how God is to be loved, and the four degrees of love: “the reason for loving God is God; the measure, to love without measure.” The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 182, 1854), from a machine-corrected OCR, with Mabillon’s Admonitio, the preface and all fifteen chapters. The English is Marianne Caroline and Coventry Patmore’s 1881 translation, which renders chapters I to XI (the treatise proper) and not the Latin’s closing chapters XII to XV, drawn from the letter to the Carthusians; the Admonitio and the preface to Haimeric are untranslated.
description.pt-BR: O pequeno tratado de Bernardo ao cardeal Haimerico sobre por que e como se deve amar a Deus, e sobre os quatro graus do amor: «a razão de amar a Deus é Deus; a medida, amar sem medida».

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854), De diligendo Deo with Mabillon’s Admonitio; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 11196, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text: Admonitio, preface and chapters I to XV with Mabillon’s chapter headings. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The Admonitio is Mabillon’s own note and is kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s 1854 printing is public domain everywhere.

sources.edition: Saint Bernard on the Love of God, translated by Marianne Caroline and Coventry Patmore (London: Burns & Oates, 2nd ed. 1884; first published Kegan Paul, 1881). Internet Archive OCR (saintbernardlove00bernuoft), with line-end hyphens restored from the second scan, https://archive.org/details/OnTheLoveOfGod.
sources.description: Chapters I to XI only. The “Fragments from a fragment” and the Three Rosaries of Our Lady that follow in the volume are not imported. OCR running heads and page numbers are removed; chapter titles are set in sentence case.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in London in 1881 and 1884; Coventry Patmore died in 1896 and Marianne in 1880s: public domain everywhere.

title.la: Caput I. Quare et quomodo diligendus sit Deus
title.en-US: Chapter I. Why we ought to love God, and how we ought to love Him

title.la: Caput II. Deus quantopere ab homine mereatur amari, ob bona tum corporis, tum animae. Quomodo ea agnoscenda et habenda citra donantis injuriam
title.en-US: Chapter II. That God has a right to the love of man because of His gifts to soul and body. How these should be confessed, and not turned against Him who gave them

title.la: Caput III. Christiani quantos habeant stimulos amandi Deum prae infidelibus
title.en-US: Chapter III. What motives Christians have, more than infidels, to love God

title.la: Caput IV. Quinam ex Dei recordatione consolationem capiant: quive magis ad ejus amorem idonei
title.en-US: Chapter IV. For whom there is comfort in the thought of God; and who are fittest to feel love for Him

title.la: Caput V. Christiano quantum incumbat debitum amoris
title.en-US: Chapter V. Of the obligation to love God, especially for Christians

title.la: Caput VI. Brevis anacephalaeosis et summa praedictorum
title.en-US: Chapter VI. A summary of what has hitherto been said

title.la: Caput VII. Non sine fructu et praemio diligi Deum; et terrenis non satiari humani cordis appetitum
title.en-US: Chapter VII. The rewards and advantage of the love of God. The heart of man is not to be satisfied by earthly things

title.la: Caput VIII. De primo gradu amoris, quo diligit homo se propter se
title.en-US: Chapter VIII. We begin by the love of self, this being for us the first degree of love

title.la: Caput IX. De secundo et tertio gradu amoris
title.en-US: Chapter IX. Of the second and third degrees of love

title.la: Caput X. De quarto gradu amoris cum nec seipsum diligit homo nisi propter Deum
title.en-US: Chapter X. The fourth degree of love is to love self only for God

title.la: Caput XI. Haec amoris perfectio non competit etiam solutis animabus beatorum, ante resurrectionem
title.en-US: Chapter XI. The saints will have perfect love only after the general resurrection
